about.heading: ABOUT
body: I work across video, image processing, and visual computing, with experience spanning both research-oriented exploration and practical software development.
I enjoy turning technical ideas into working systems — understanding how things work, testing different approaches, and refining them with efficiency and real-world constraints in mind.
My interests have gradually expanded from traditional image and video processing to computer vision, compression, and AI-based visual systems.
I value engineering that is not only accurate, but also efficient, understandable, and practical to use.
